gpu-copy.note: Hardware decode, frames shown through the GPU. Use when dmabuf-wayland freezes the HDMI picture (seen on pi-4 with a Beyond TV panel): set renderer to gpu-copy in /etc/pi5-signage.json.

validation.tested_device: Raspberry Pi 5 Model B Rev 1.1 (pi-3), Raspberry Pi OS Bookworm arm64, mpv 0.35.1, FHD HDMI-A-1 panel
validation.notes: Fresh install, unattended boot and looping verified on pi-3 with hwdec=drm (auto-safe does not select the drm hwdec in Debian mpv 0.35.1 and fails at hwupload). H.264 has no Pi 5 hardware decoder and is not renderable by dmabuf-wayland. Not yet verified: 4K60, audio, 12 h soak test.
